title: Chambery
identity: Dorn catalog identifies Chambery by Yvonne Desportes as soprano saxophone and organ or oboe and organ (Dorn 858); BnF separately catalogs an oboe-organ version.

evidence.claim: Opened Dorn 2024 catalog lists Chambery as soprano saxophone/organ or oboe/organ.
BnF result catalogues Chambery for organ and oboe, a separate matching scoring option.

Bibliothèque nationale de France catalogs a facsimile of Chambery for oboe and organ (1976); this corroborates the oboe version but does not establish whether the saxophone option in Dorn is a separate arrangement or shares the same part.

review_focus: Verify the soprano part in the Dorn score, including whether identical to oboe part, and inspect ensemble balance and movement sequence.
collection_flag: Chamber work with alternative wind instrument; oboe catalog record alone does not establish saxophone version's demands.
gaps: No soprano-saxophone notation or matching performance was inspected.
The opened Dorn listing and BnF record show soprano saxophone/organ and oboe/organ options, but whether the parts are identical is unresolved.
Movement titles and reported 60-page extent were not independently verified.
searches: Yvonne Desportes Chambery soprano sax organ Dorn 858 score
